title: TelemetryEvent
description: Canonical vehicle telemetry event, schema_version 1. SINGLE source of truth for the event contract (CLAUDE.md S7): simulator, processor, API and tests all validate against this file. Extends the illustrative event in the hackathon PDF S8, which lacks the ignition/engine/fuel signals that idle detection requires (D7).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bumping this requires a migration plus a contract test update (CLAUDE.md S17).

event_id.description: UUIDv7: time-ordered, so it indexes well as a unique key in the sink. Final dedup safety net (G10).

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. NEVER trusted from an API request body; on the ingest path it is device-bound (CLAUDE.md S3).

vin.description: 17 characters, excludes I/O/Q. Check digit validated in code, not expressible in JSON Schema (PDF S9).

seq.description: Monotonic per-VIN sequence. Enables an O(1) per-vehicle high-water-mark dedup that scales to 100K events/s without one key per event (CLAUDE.md S8, G10).

ts.description: EVENT time, UTC RFC3339 with milliseconds. All business logic uses this, never processing time (CLAUDE.md S8).

speed_kph.description: Ground speed. Above the maximum the event is rejected to the DLQ as physically impossible.

odometer_km.description: Cumulative distance, expected monotonic per VIN; a decrease is a data-quality signal.

ignition.description: Authoritative engine-power state used by idle detection together with speed_kph (D1).

engine_state.description: Device-reported state. Treated as a HINT only: OEMs compute it inconsistently, so our own idle logic derives state from ignition + speed and stays testable (D7).

fuel_level_pct.description: Tank level. Coarse (~1% resolution), so it is a cross-check, not the primary fuel source (D2).

fuel_rate_lph.description: Instantaneous consumption. When present, drives the secondary measured-fuel cross-check (D2).

soc_pct.description: Battery state of charge, EV/hybrid only. Powertrain itself lives on the vehicle master, not on every event, to avoid a second source of truth and save bytes at 100K/s (D7/D9).

lat.description: Precise coordinates are NEVER written to logs and are masked for roles that do not need them (CLAUDE.md S11).

gps_valid.description: False marks an untrustworthy fix; idle segmentation must not split a segment on a bad fix (D1 gap tolerance).

dtc.description: OBD-II fault codes, e.g. P0301 (PDF S9 parsing requirement).

evt.description: Discrete event marker, when the device emits one.

pto_active.description: Power take-off (refrigeration unit, crane, lift) engaged. Optional idle exclusion, default off (D1).
